verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI documents non-interactive scripting mode with JSON/stream-JSON output for workflow automation, plus a GitHub Actions integration that automatically triages issues and reviews PRs without manual invocation, both of which support autonomous background automation. However, there's no dedicated scheduler/cron-like mechanism documented and no independent evidence confirming long-running unattended background sessions work reliably (community feedback focuses on interactive coding quality, not background automation specifically). Missing for 10: native scheduling/trigger system beyond GitHub Actions, first-party docs on setting up persistent background daemons, and hands-on validation that non-interactive runs complete complex tasks unattended.
